xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4479: Shared Sessions v0 (slice 8): host reconnect and viewer auto-restore

plan.title: Shared Sessions v0 (slice 8): host reconnect and viewer auto-restore
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: A host share dies on the first hiccup: ShareManager (src/dashboard/server/services/share-host.ts) never reconnects the host socket and never re-parks on boot (slice-2 D-1), so a network drop or a pan reload loses the share although the room survives 5 minutes on the share service and the host token is still in ${OVERDECK_HOME}/shared-sessions.json. After a process restart the new PeerHub's host-admitted set is empty and a snapshot can never add an id (slice-3 D-12), so even a re-parked host would never offer a peer. The viewer server turns any unexpected join-socket close into 'disconnected' with a manual Rejoin (slice-4 D-8), and a lost browser peer needs a manual Reconnect click (slice-4 D-11).
narratives.Proposal: Host: reconnect the host socket in the same process on a backoff table SHARE_RECONNECT_DELAYS_MS = [1s,2s,4s,8s,15s,30s] keeping the hub, with a new ShareConnection 'reconnecting'; stop only on 404/401/4004 (remove record) or 4008 (disconnected, no retry); End share on a share that is not connected forgets it locally when the service cannot be reached. Add ShareManager.resume(), called once at boot from main.ts on the primary dashboard (hostsMachineLinks()), which re-parks every record; the first room frame after a re-park seeds the hub's host-admitted set with the snapshot's admitted participants via hub.admit, exactly once, so reconcile() re-offers every admitted connected viewer. Viewer server: a seated join (one that got a status frame) reconnects on the same backoff with a new JoinState 'reconnecting'; unseated joins keep 'disconnected'. Viewer page: 'reconnecting' is live and shows a banner over the kept timeline; the timeline stays while a new offer negotiates; a lost peer while admitted auto-restarts the event stream after 5 s, at most 3 tries. Prove it with fake-timer unit tests and two Miniflare integration tests (restart inside the window restores without the lobby; a gone room removes the record and re-joining goes through the lobby). Update docs/SHARED-SESSIONS.md and configuration/shared-sessions.mdx.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Viewer dashboard restart auto-rejoin (joins live in viewer-server memory; the page keeps its 'Lost the connection to your Overdeck.' Try again screen)
- Any change to services/share/ (Worker, ShareRoom reducer, alarm, protocol)
- Persisting the host-admitted set or any participant data on the host
- Retrying after close 4008 or arbitrating between two dashboards sharing one OVERDECK_HOME
- Re-parking on a peer dashboard (hostsMachineLinks() false) or re-parking again when anywhere.share_url changes after boot
- A give-up limit on host or viewer reconnect attempts
- Host-side automatic re-offer of a failed peer without a new snapshot (no PeerHub code change)
- Adding ShareManager.stop() to dashboard shutdown
- pan share / pan join CLI (slice 9), controller handoff (slice 7), drafts (slice 5), terminal channel (slice 6)
- New HTTP routes or no-loss-matrix rows

autoDecisions.summary: Backoff table SHARE_RECONNECT_DELAYS_MS = [1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, 15000, 30000], last value repeats, reset on success, no give-up limit, shared by host and viewer server.
autoDecisions.rationale: The host cannot tell from its own clock whether the service's 5-minute alarm fired (the service measures from when it saw the close), so only the service's 404/4004 answer may end the loop; a 30 s cap keeps many tries inside the window at negligible cost.

autoDecisions.summary: Re-park is ShareManager.resume(), called from main.ts right after startAnywhere, gated on hostsMachineLinks().
autoDecisions.rationale: A peer dashboard sharing ~/.overdeck re-parking the same room would replace the primary's host socket with close 4008; main.ts has 14 lines of ceiling headroom and the hook needs 2.

autoDecisions.summary: After a process restart, the first room frame seeds the hub's host-admitted set from the snapshot's admitted participants, once, via the existing hub.admit; created and same-process-reconnected hosts are never seeded.
autoDecisions.rationale: Slice-3 D-12 reserved exactly this for slice 8 and the parent PRD's data model keeps participants only in the service; the service admits only on host-socket frames (D-R3-3), so the list is the host's own prior decisions, and the service already relays the DTLS fingerprints (D-R3-1).

autoDecisions.summary: Add 'reconnecting' to both ShareConnection and JoinState instead of reusing 'connecting'.
autoDecisions.rationale: A distinct value makes the state observable in the API, UI and tests and lets the viewer page keep the timeline under a banner instead of a full Connecting panel.

autoDecisions.summary: Only a seated join (one that received a status frame) auto-reconnects; an unseated join keeps 'disconnected' with Rejoin.
autoDecisions.rationale: A first connect that fails should give an explicit error instead of an endless spinner; a viewer who was already in the room or lobby should come back on its own.

autoDecisions.summary: The viewer page restarts the event stream 5 s after the peer goes lost while admitted, at most 3 times in a row, keeping messages.
autoDecisions.rationale: If a host network drop kills peers but not the host socket, no snapshot arrives and the hub never re-offers; the bounded page-side restart is the only automatic path back and avoids a 35-second loop forever.

autoDecisions.summary: The after-the-window integration test ends the room with deleteRoom() while the host is down instead of waiting for the Durable Object alarm.
autoDecisions.rationale: Miniflare cannot fire the 5-minute alarm without real waiting and tests may not sleep; the reducer's alarm and delete share the same end branch, and the alarm itself is covered by room-state.test.ts describe('alarm').

autoDecisions.summary: ShareManagerDeps and JoinManagerDeps gain optional reconnectDelaysMs; integration tests pass [0].
autoDecisions.rationale: Repo rule: no real setTimeout delays in tests; integration tests use real sockets so the delay must be injectable.

autoDecisions.summary: End share on a share that is not connected forgets it locally (drop host, remove record, 204) when the share service cannot be reached; a connected share keeps 500/502.
autoDecisions.rationale: With no reconnect give-up and 'reconnecting' counted as live, create() returns the stuck share as existing, so End share must always work; the room, if alive, ends itself on the service's 5-minute alarm. Same rule slice-2 D-3 applies to stale records.
